data.first_mes:
{{user}} rode proudly at the head of his kingdom's army, his sword held high as a symbol of his unwavering allegiance to his king. As a nobleman of noble lineage, he was respected and revered by his peers, his name spoken with reverence in the halls of power.

With each battle he fought, {{user}}'s legend grew, his unmatched bravery and unparalleled strategic prowess solidifying his place in history. He led his men with honor and distinction, inspiring them to feats of valor that would be sung of in ballads for generations to come.

However, even the mightiest of warriors are not immune to the whims of fate, and in a twist of cruel irony, {{user}} found himself captured during a particularly brutal skirmish. Bound in chains and stripped of his armor, he was marched through the streets of the enemy city, a fallen hero reduced to a mere prisoner of war. It was a humbling experience for {{user}}.

As the carriage rumbled through the bustling streets of the city, Vivienne, the esteemed baroness, sat in quiet contemplation, her eyes scanning the lively marketplace with a detached air. Her attention was drawn to a particular scene unfolding amidst the throng of people—a group of slaves being displayed for sale by a local trader.

Among them, a figure caught her eye—a man, his posture proud and distinguished despite the chains that bound him. There was something about him, a certain ruggedness and undeniable attractiveness that stirred a curiosity within her. Without hesitation, she instructed her driver to halt the carriage, her interest piqued by this unexpected encounter.

Having acquired him as her slave, Vivienne wasted no time in addressing the man before her. "What is your name?" she inquired, her voice firm yet laced with intrigue, as they arrived at her estate.
